messages.author: f53f4ca2c430170d
messages.subject: Generalized gamma
parts:
I'm fitting a three-parameter generalized gamma distribution to some timing data and (unsurprisingly) the parameter posteriors are multi-modal and widely separated enough that it causes problems for applying the naive parameterization routinely.  I am curious if anyone has had insights/experience with a parameterization that's robust for use with Stan/HMC.  I am working on comparing a variety of parameterizations and how they fail but so far no clear winners. 

Krzysztof
